notes_for_editor: Brief lists agency AFC. The Register says 'Administered by AFC' (cite 2), so agency is now in facts; the Register uses the abbreviation and the brief expands it. No source read says who built the tower, so the story names no builder beyond the survey note and the agency-wide CCC and AFC context. Build date, staffing, fires and public access were not found; the Register itself says the build date is unknown. The 1955 station description implies the tower stood by 1955; the story says so only as a survey note. Height conflict, not resolved: the 1955 survey gives about 130 ft (height_m 39.6 is from this figure) and the Register's description says a 100ft Aermotor; the story reports both. Locals Wandering is posted July 4, 2026 (07/04/2026) and is the only source for current standing.
